title: Barnaby Bear and the Quiet Signs Treasure Hunt
moral: Careful thinking reveals what rushing misses.

scenes.text: Barnaby discovers a tin box with strange objects and a note about a treasure hunt.
scenes.image_prompt: bear opening tin box with mysterious objects inside forest den

scenes.summary: He meets Felix and starts the hunt.
scenes.text: Barnaby teams up with Felix and begins solving clues hidden in the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: bear and fox examining clue near old stone bridge

scenes.text: They decode clues at the bridge, singing stones, and other hidden places.
scenes.image_prompt: forest clearing with large stones glowing slightly as clues

scenes.text: They solve riddles during a storm, discovering more puzzle pieces.
scenes.image_prompt: bear and fox inside old tower during storm solving puzzle

scenes.text: By staying patient and observant, they move closer to uncovering the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: bear holding completed puzzle pieces glowing softly

story: Barnaby and Felix follow subtle clues hidden in nature to uncover a treasure. Through patience and observation, they learn that careful thinking leads to success.
